G3: The mechanism describes true effect-modification pathways (increased treatment-related harms and shorter time-to-benefit in older/frail patients) rather than mere absolute-risk amplification, so a causal HTE is plausible. G5: Age and frailty define measurable, operational subgroups (age bands, frailty indices, CVD burden) that can guide differential treatment decisions, so the hypothesis is clinically actionable.
scored_features.justification: Decisive pass at G3: the hypothesis specifies treatment-related harms and competing mortality as mechanisms by which age changes net benefit (a genuine effect modifier), and this is supported by trial contrasts and geriatric physiology, allowing subsequent gates to be true.
